status: Cargo's detail spec, the Bay (T-20261016-216, built to results/T-20261016-197/build-spec.md sections 1 to 6, as amended at 1cb34829): the bay window with three or four berths, the Pods hatch with its six wells and the find strip, the waiting mat, the display row for the open crate's contents, the opening crate by crate, and the end. The dock arrival (state arrival, T-20261016-120) keeps its own regions under the dock names until it is rebuilt. Section 7 (Open the bay | Later) is a follow-on.
note: Rectangles are [x, y, w, h] in screen pixels at 1x on 1024 x 600; `at` offsets are from the region's own origin. The stage is the frame's (0, 40, 1024, 522); the top bar and the bottom line are the frame's. Every picture is placed at 1:1: nothing is scaled and nothing is anti-aliased.
stateRule: bay: at rest, the berths with their crates sealed (or slatted and shut), the hatch shut, any waiting pods on the mat. opening: the crates open one at a time, left to right, the portrait crate last (events.opening), input held but for ✓ Skip, ← and a room key. end: after the last crate, until a key; the next key does its action and the bay shows again. arrival: the dock show (regions.arrival)

conditions.away: the Companion is not in the Caddy: no walk crates; the door is shut unless a sitting crate or a waiting pod is in the bay, and a ready sitting crate opens as docked
conditions.docked: the door follows what the bay holds (R2): one sealed crate per crate the Companion brought, at most three, or a waiting pod, with the door open; with nothing, the door is shut

panel.from: the Companion's dock, at the show's end (regions.arrival.end): the strip form
panel.closes: Later, ← or a room key: the arrival dithers back to the screen it came over, as it was; Open the bay: the strip goes and the opening runs

notes.motion: Reduced motion (props.motion false): every travel is a cut to its end and every dither is a cut (build spec 8.3). The opening ends at once on the face, so the host sends events.opening once at 0 (ms and hold unchanged) and stages regions.opening.crate and .at, stepping `at` through the same step times as events.opening.steps (0, 200, 500, 700 and each material's 150 after it, 1500, each pod's and find's start, the last + 300). An item that travels is drawn at its destination from its start time, already swapped to its stored size. The total time is the same, so Skip and ← behave alike in both modes.
notes.dither: No Cargo dither is a stage exemption (architect, results/T-20261016-216/architect-dither.md). The contents' dither-in covers the display rect only (at most 144,000 px); a pod or a find swaps size with v_dither_window as two nodes on one level clock, out from the travel picture to clear, then in from clear to the stored picture (each at most 11,776 px). A dither at the run's end to another screen stays the screen change.

beats.do: the bay shows (the screen's dither, 180 ms; on Cargo itself no transition)
the ribbon's words; the link light's first step; the first crate starts to slide
the band: the Probe's plates and who leaves
each mibi dithers in, then hops (regions.arrival.mibis)
one cut: the rack and the strip

show.rule: kind arrival, target show: the face's own clock reads the beats; ✓ Skip (any key) cuts to 3500; with reduced motion (props.motion false) the host stages regions.arrival.at at each beat's time and each is a cut

opening.ms: the last crate's start + its length (regions.opening.starts, .lens); the host sends whole ms
opening.focus: the room; no ring; no key moves it
opening.held: while the opening holds, the face sends `confirm` and `back` on "room" as well as room:<x> (and ends its own hold); the pad sends nothing. The host applies the current crate's end state: ✓ then restarts the event for the remaining crates with starts rebased to 0 (the last crate: the end), ← opens no further crate and goes Home, a room key does what ← does and then opens its room. A Dock waits for the end.
opening.props: the props' regions.opening: starts (ms from the event's start, one for each crate, the first 0), lens, and the crates' contents; the crate and the step in it come from the arrival event's own clock (the last start <= elapsed), or with reduced motion from regions.opening.crate and .at

crates.rule: at most nine crates play (hold <= 30000); a run whose hold would pass it plays the crates that fit, the rest are taken in by the rule when the run ends

focus.room: the ring on nothing: Cargo has no targets; ✓ does the bottom line's action, the pad does nothing
focus.held: while events.opening holds, the face sends `confirm` and `back` on "room" as well as room:<x> (build spec 8.4); the pad sends nothing. A Dock during the opening is kept by the host (by parity: two presses cancel) and acts when the end shows.
focus.end: while the end shows, any key does what it does and then the bay shows again: ✓ follows the bottom line, ← is Home, a room key opens its room, the pad only closes it

confirm.bay: a crate ready to open (walk crates while docked, a ready sitting crate): the opening (events.opening); else nothing, no ✓ cap
confirm.opening: Skip: the current crate cuts to its end (everything arrived) and the next crate starts; on the last crate, the end
confirm.end: Look at the pods: the jump to Pods (frame.json navigation.jumps), the ring on the newest pod; with no pod, no ✓ cap

back.bay: Home, the ring on the Bay module
back.opening: lets the current crate finish as a cut, opens no further crate, then Home with the ring on the Bay module; the crates not yet opened stay sealed

keys.dock: the Caddy's Dock, a world event, never a Station key. Docked while the bay shows: each crate cuts in, in its berth, sealed (no slide, no door). Lifted while the bay shows: the crates leave the berths as a cut. During the opening it waits until the end shows. No message plate: the bay, the top bar's Companion mark and the context line say it. A refused Dock shows its plate.

crates.when: a crate is ready to open: walk crates while docked, a ready sitting crate docked or away
crates.subject: the waiting line when a pod waits, else empty

nothing.subject: the waiting line when a pod waits, else empty

show.action: strings.arrival.skip while the show runs (any key skips to the choice)
show.subject: strings.subjects.crates, or strings.subjects.empty when none came

arrival.choice: the decision panel's strip form: ✓ + the focused card's name, the card's line, back Later (panel.json strings.dock)

opening.subject: the waiting line when a pod has just gone to the mat, else empty
opening.back: Home (lets the current crate finish as a cut first)

end.action: strings.newPods when a pod came; none otherwise
end.subject: the waiting line when a pod waits, else empty

handoff.rule: a crate's pods land in the hatch's six wells: Pods' collection shows them in the same wells, new until identified. ✓ Look at the pods on the end jumps to Pods' collection with the ring on the newest pod; ← there reads Home. A pod with no free well waits on the mat (regions.waiting) and lands, oldest first, as a well frees

arrival.broken: The Companion is home. Nothing came back this time.
arrival.rule: the ribbon at 20, the band words at 16; measured: "The Companion is home" and the broken line fit the ribbon (words + 32 ≤ 608), "three mended, free" ≤ 160; the choice strip's names and lines are panel.json strings.dock

subjects.waitingOne: a pod waits for a well

placeholders.pod: the display's pod is the collection class, 88×112; the stored pod is the list class (the well masters), 40×48
placeholders.cuts: the bay, the berths' recess, shut door and edges, the lit well, the done crates and the waiting mat are cut by prototypes/ui/tools/cargo-cuts.py from placed masters, no painting
placeholders.dockPlaceholders: regions.dock* and regions.arrival keep the arrival's own pictures

bay.offGrid: placed by the build spec (section 1): the art director's composition puts it off the 8 px grid
bay.rule: one image: the back wall, the floor and the bay's one light from the top left; radius 6 with the frame's inner shade, as every window (the corners outside the radius in the stage ground, a 1 px void edge on the radius)

hatch.offGrid: placed by the build spec (section 1): the art director's composition puts it off the 8 px grid

wells.rule: from the hatch's origin, in rack order

frame.rule: a 3 px sage rim round the hatch, shut and open, cut by cargo-cuts.py

mat.rule: the mat, built at build time by cargo-cuts.py: radius 8, fill #383e36, a 1 px outline #546052, a 1 px top line #282c26 from x + 8 to x + w − 9

pods.rule: up to three stored pods, the row centred by count (1 at 84; 2 at 60 and 108; 3 at 36, 84, 132), oldest at the left; the row re-lays as a cut; a fourth or more: the row starts at x 32 and "+{n}" (n = the pods past the third) is right-aligned at x 180

display.offGrid: placed by the build spec (section 1 and 2): the art director's composition puts it off the 8 px grid
display.fit: when the row is wider than 800 the materials use the 48 × 64 pictures and 16 px amounts; if it is still wider the finds after the first stay in the crate until the materials have left

berths.offGrid: placed by the build spec (section 3): the art director's composition puts it off the 8 px grid
berths.rule: walk crates (at most three): three berths of 256 in arrival order; with a portrait crate in: four berths of 188, the portrait crate in the fourth, opening last. Each berth is its recess (always under a crate) or its slatted shut door, the crate and its shadow, and the berth's edge (a 1 px rounded outline at the rect − 1 and a lip along the bottom), the fourth berth's gold edge on top

travel.ease: in-out: p = min(1000, t·1000/600); e = p·p·(3000 − 2p)/1000000 (64-bit); pos = from + (to − from)·e/1000, integer division truncating toward zero; at p = 1000 exactly to
travel.path: a straight line, whole pixels, eased in and out; nothing is scaled; only the portrait leaves the bay

dockBay.rule: R2: open when it holds a walk crate, a ready sitting crate or a waiting pod, and in the opening; shut when it holds nothing, and in the report; in the report the door is slices.report (GB-R6); each change a cut. The open bay is the painting, drawn 1:1; the door goes 1:1 over it. The back wall runs from y 64 to about 238, the floor from about 240 to 352, its lip to 356, the rim 8 px (measured; nothing is placed by them but the feet lines)

states.shut: the door: nothing held, or the report
states.open: the painting: a walk crate, a ready sitting crate or a waiting pod, and the opening

dockBay.rule2: kept for the dock arrival (regions.arrival) until it is rebuilt on the new bay

dockCrates.order: walk crates left to right in the order they open, sitting crates after them; the places are fixed by n on the Dock frame (crates sliding in never re-centre)

shadow.when: from the frame its crate has landed; a crate still sliding casts none

dockCrates.overflow: more than three crates (developer only): the first three in bayCrates order show, walk crates first; no others are drawn; the context line counts all

sitting.places: after the walk crates, at the group's right end; at most three crates show, walk crates first

lamp.rule: under its crate, at (place.x + 122, 304) of its place by count: the rows lit from the bottom, floor(10 × crateLamp) in sky, the rest hairline; full only when ready

sitting.opens: a ready sitting crate opens in Cargo after the walk crates, in the same sequence, docked or away; its ribbon is strings.ribbon.sitting. It gets no row on the report; when only sitting crates opened, no report card shows and the bay shows at the end
sitting.revealNote: what the opened sitting crate shows (its portrait's reveal) is not designed yet (station-layouts.md, Not designed yet); until it is, a build leaves sitting crates out of the bay

dockCrates.rule2: kept for the dock arrival (regions.arrival) until it is rebuilt on the new bay

pod.note: the collection class, as Pods' collection draws it, rendered at 88×112

dockRack.rule: the six places of the rack, the same pods in the same order as Pods' collection: an empty well, or its pod; a pod still travelling leaves its well empty until it lands; the wells are the insert's painting (an object, not an outline): the face draws no panel, rule or well
dockRack.rule2: kept for the dock arrival (regions.arrival) until it is rebuilt on the new bay

fit.w: words + 2 × pad, rounded up to 8, at least 160

dockRibbon.bound: the rect is the widest the ribbon may be; it shows only from 500 ms, 28 px above the closer's ink and 8 px above the pods' boxes
dockRibbon.rule2: kept for the dock arrival (regions.arrival) until it is rebuilt on the new bay

arrival.offGrid: the bay (16, 48, 992 × 320) and the apron (16, 368, 992 × 180) together, to y 548
arrival.rule: the Companion's dock as a show on the bay, then one choice: the bay (regions.dockBay, drawn as today), the apron in the rack's place for the show, the ribbon, the link light, the crates sliding in from the left, a glint on a crate holding a new species, the mibis who came home standing big on the apron, the Probe's plates and who leaves in the bay's top corners. At the show's end one cut: the apron gives way to the rack and the choice strip (panel.json form strip) stands over it. Every number is here; the times are ms from the dock

apron.note: drawn from the dither's end at 200 to the show's end, in the rack's place

light.rule: runs in from the bay's left edge: step k (0 to 3) shows the first (k + 1) × 244 px of the picture from 500 + 100 k ms, each a cut; whole from 800 on

crates.rule: crate i slides in from x −256 to its place over 400 ms in whole pixels from 500 + 333 i; its shadow shows from the frame it lands; more than three: the first three slide in and the strip's line counts all

glint.rule: at (crate x + 232, 128) from its crate's landing, on a crate holding a pod of a species new to the player: where, never what

hop.rule: the hatch's table (incubator.json events.hatch): [ms into the hop, px above the feet line], each a cut, whole pixels

mibis.layer: in front of the crates and their glints; carried order, left to right; a mibi without its painting shows its labelled placeholder at the same size
mibis.rule: mibi i (from 0) dithers in alone at 1600 + 500 i over 300 ms (16 levels, in place), then makes one hop; only one big picture changes per frame

probe.rule: one icon a whole plate, the whole ones first; at 2500 the mended ones turn whole one by one, 120 ms apart (a cut each); the words after the icons from the first mended one, none when none was mended

leaving.placeholder: a species without its face-{species}-24 shows a 24 × 24 stone plate with a mist edge (the register's placeholder); nothing is drawn in words instead
leaving.rule: right-aligned to x 984: the mark, then the faces of the mibis who leave with the Companion at this dock; with no one leaving, the corner is empty. Both groups sit beside the ribbon (208 to 816), never under it

arrival.ribbon: regions.ribbon, from 500 ms to the end: strings.arrival.ribbon, or strings.arrival.broken when nothing came back because the Probe broke

end.rule: the show's end, 3500 ms (at most 3600): one cut, counted as a screen change: the mibis are gone, the apron gives way to the rack, the choice strip appears over it

autoClose.rule: an empty trip and a broken Probe have no choice: at 2500 the arrival dithers back (frame.json idle wake transition, 180 ms) to the screen it came over

arrival.skip: any key during the show cuts to the show's end (✓, ← or the pad); a room key is Later, then it acts; reduced motion: every beat is a cut on its time, a mibi appears as a cut with no hop
